notes.title: Bride for the Princess Full Release!

[h1]Our latest Visual Novel has left Early Access and is now a full release![/h1]

It'll have a special launch discount of -15% off the full price. We hope that you'll enjoy playing it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144550/Bride_for_the_Princess/

notes.title: Version 3.1
notes.notes:
[b]Balance[/b]

[list][*]Michi's Provoke now takes priority over any other potential taunts.
[*]Lowered the power of Bentley's Sneak Attack damage towards bosses to 70% of move power (was 85%).
[*]Mean Imp now has similar Sneak Attack power reduction as rest of the bosses.
[*]Increased base power of Grenade to 85 (was 50)
[*]Increased base power of Eye Poke to 10 (was 0)
[*]Increased base power of Tongue of Flames to 150 (was 100)
[*]Increased base power of Bleeding Blitz to 20 (was 0)
[*]Increased base power of Slash to 50 (was 30)
[*]Increased base power of Dual Attack to 50 (was 0)
[*]Increased base power of Judgment Fracture to 30 (was 0)
[*]Increased base power of Stun Shot to 30 (was 0)
[*]Increased base power of Point Shot to 30 (was 0)
[*]Increased base power of Rainbow Hit to 30 (was 0)
[*]Lowered starting HP of Genie to 492 (was 544)
[*]Fire Weapon buff now grants 130% attack buff (was 110%)
[*]Ice Weapon buff now grants 130% attack buff (was 110%)
[*]Thunder Weapon buff now grants 130% attack buff (was 110%)
[*]Removed extra enemy protections from Shooting Stars
[*]Lowered Block Chance of Shield Wall status to 15% (was 35%)
[*]Enemy rivals now have small buffs to make up for not being able to get gear, especially frail rivals will see huge increase in survivability thanks to this
[*]Bentley as rival has similar speed debuff as regular Bentley for using guns
[*]Special Boss has higher level buffs to reflect high level gear
[*]Increased Special Boss ai to 100 (was 90)[/list]

[b]DLC[/b]

[list][*]Lowered Target Rate for Pain Queen to 50%  (was 100%)
[*]Rafflesia now has similar Sneak Attack power reduction as rest of the bosses.[/list]

notes.title: Version 2.0 - Pain Queen
notes.notes:
We have released the first DLC character for Strangers of the Power 2 and patch to go along with it

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080840/Strangers_of_the_Power_2__Pain_Queen_character/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652543/88631a4068e6854ea60c1413c328c66bdacb5847.png[/img]

[b]Achievement[/b]

[list][*]"F5", Reach level 25 with Prisca[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]

[list][*]Reduced all enemy healing spells cast likeliness to 75%
[*]Ice Spirits are now weak to Fire
[*]Ice Spirits are no longer weak to Light magic
[*]All Fire Elementals are weak to Ice
[*]Aurae learns Falcon Thrust at lvl 4 (was 5)
[*]Aurae learns Flare at lvl 6 (was 8)
[*]Aurae learns Stun Shot at lvl 8 (was 12)
[*]Aurae learns Rainbow Hit at lvl 12 (was 15)
[*]Aurae learns Rain Shot at lvl 16 (was 20)
[*]Bentley's Sneak Attack is now its own unique element for balancing reasons
[*]All bosses are only 85% weak to Bentley's Sneak Attack element (opossed to 100%)[/list]

[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]Miracle didn't cure zombie state like it was supposed to, this has been fixed
[*]Playing as Bentley, you could get too strong loot gear on the lava stage under specific circumstances, this has been fixed
[*]Lightsources sometime appeared before scene transition, this has been fixed
[*]When playing local co op, the followers didn't trigger damage floor, this has been fixed
[*]Rare and specific problem which required that Slavia was main rival, Bentley was their friend, Miwafin was the third follower and Michi was the fourth caused the battle to be entirely skipped, this has been fixed[/list]

[b]Camera[/b]

[list][*]Improved map scrolling[/list]

[b]Crafting[/b]

[list][*]Alchemy now only shows craftable items[/list]

[b]DLC[/b]

[list][*]Pain Queen playable character added[/list]

[b]Gamepad[/b]

[list][*]Some battle phase problems when using gamepad have been fixed
[*]Some minor tweaks and fixes to gamepads[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list][*]Added more random chance to Rival System
[*]Added "Buy more" option to shop[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]

[list][*]Loot aquired from battles now drops to battlefield
[*]Bust graphics now have breathing animation[/list]

Performance

[list][*]Various performance tweaks[/list]

[b]Popups[/b]

[list][*]New popup markers when looting chests[/list]

[b]Weapons[/b]

[list][*]Added Whips [/list]
